body.description: A range or a chart of a CalcGrid document as a table: set the query parameters definitionId (the document) and range (as in a formula, Summary!A1:D20; its first row names the columns) or chart (a chart's id: a label column and a column for each series), and profileId to read under an access profile. Read as the viewer under their current CalcGrid access, or the profile named.

parameters.name: chart
parameters.label: Chart (its id, in place of a range)
